ai.title: Adjust isSketchComplete prompt for LOCALCHANGEONLY
ai.summary: Modified the `isSketchComplete` prompt in `backend/src/generate-patch.ts` to soften the condition for returning `LOCAL_CHANGE_ONLY`. The strong prior language was removed, requiring the model to simply 'believe' the scenario rather than 'strongly believe' it, while maintaining `REPLACE_ENTIRE_FILE` as the default fallback.

eli5.text: When the assistant helps rewrite part of a file instead of the whole thing, it now only needs to think the change looks intentional rather than feel very confident about it before deciding to update just that section. Previously, it had to strongly believe the scenario; now a regular belief is enough, making that judgment call slightly less strict. This affects what happens behind the scenes when the system checks whether the assistant meant to change a whole file or just a piece of it. This change is live today.
